name: Prism Wirebraid
description: Salute with the cord held in both hands, then lower it to a guard across the belly.

name: Peremptory Garrote
description: Lay two open loops over the hands and cast the nearer one first, the farther a breath later.

name: Cinch Solace
description: Pace forward with the head high and the cords low, like a hawk walking through grass.

name: Venerable Gripdowel
description: Turn the wrist inside a loop to carry a grasp past the cord and off the body.

name: Toggle Banner
description: Draw the pair in a measured beat, left, right, left, so the strain never lets go.

name: Thrall Constrict
description: Seat a thread of qi in the cord's knot so the loop holds without constant pull.

name: Sigilstrand
description: Close both loops at once on neck and wrist so the target cannot lift an arm to the cord.

name: Guileful Wirecore
description: Set a paired cord at the foot of a staircase so a hurried descent ends in a fall.

name: Prism Barbedwire
description: Draw the pair through the guard on one reckoned line that no armor turns aside.

name: Sigil Throttle
description: Close the paired cords in the school's final seal, binding the target's qi and breath until the hands let go.

name: Noosering Vow
description: Breathe on two counts, in through the body and out through the cord, while holding the guard.

name: Thrall Slipknot
description: Cast twin loops on different lines, one at the body and one at the weapon arm.

name: Squall Slipnoose
description: Cross the feet on a counter-step so the cord passes behind the target while the body faces front.

name: Famed Handlebar
description: Pull with the back and legs only, letting the arms carry no more than the line.

name: Toggleseal
description: Hold the loop shut on the qi track alone while the body track retreats to safe ground.

name: Delugestrand
description: Cross the tracks in front of the chest to receive a blow and send it out sideways.

name: Entropy Barbedwire
description: Draw the body track one way while the qi track slips the loop the other way.

name: Thralltoggle
description: Join the body and qi tracks at the neck in a choke that holds a stronger foe.

name: Snaring Cordhandle
description: Place two cords in the pattern of a basin's rim so a target walking its edge is caught.

name: Millstone Noosering
description: Run both tracks at full strength down the cords so the target's resistance and qi sag together.

name: Tenetwire
description: Chain the body-track cast, the qi-track hold and the joined close into the school's finishing sequence.

name: Sacrosanct Slipknot
description: Hold the cords wide and high, like a hawk on its perch, to cover head and neck.

name: Millstone Handlebar
description: Throw the loop downward from a raised stance onto a lowered head.

name: Dunetoggle
description: Step with the cords trailing behind like folded wings, never letting them brush the ground.

name: Thunderclap Tighten
description: Hook the loop on the pulse point of the wrist and tear the weapon hand loose.

name: Wirevow
description: Cast a shadow with the raised cord across the eyes, then drop in behind it.

name: Peal Wirebraid
description: Lift the cord on a rising wrist to bounce a downward cut aside.

name: Imperious Throttle
description: Dive from a step or rail onto the target's shoulders and close the loop in the fall.

name: Sigiltoggle
description: Fix a pair of cords at a window or rail so one who climbs through is caught.

name: Tranquil Wirecore
description: Read the tension of the whole body through the cord and strike where it thins.

name: Grand Destiny Cordbraid
description: Stoop from a height, close the loop, turn and draw in the court's last stoop, ending the contest in one motion.

name: Strandtroth
description: Stand with the feet apart as on a riverbank and hold the cord across the hips as a guard.

name: Millstone Cordbraid
description: Cast the loop low and smooth, skipping it over the ground like a flat stone to an ankle.

name: Squall Cordhandle
description: Walk the line of the stream, steady and unhurried, so the target never marks the approach.

name: Authoritative Slipnoose
description: Bend the knees and hold the loop fast at the neck while the target's weight drags downward.

name: Seasonnoose
description: Pull with the even force of a current that neither rests nor hurries.

name: Consecrated Barbedwire
description: Release the cord into a turning eddy of slack that sweeps a thrusting hand to one side.

name: Tighten Vow
description: Tie the loop to a belt hook in a pooling knot so the pull holds without hands.

name: Pealtoggle
description: Lay the cord on the target's shoulder and feel the ripple of his muscles before he moves.

name: Thrall Garrote
description: Surge with the full strength of a flood to take a heavy opponent off his feet by the loop.

name: Wiretroth
description: Lay cords across a shallow ford so a wading pursuer is caught at the shin and held fast.

name: Fearless Constrict
description: Draw as a deep river draws a swimmer, slow and certain, until the target's qi runs dry.

name: Resonant Cinch Crown
description: Perform the lineage's full sequence of cast, bend, anchor and flood draw, closing the loop as the whole school teaches.

name: Stalwart Gripdowel
description: Hold the cords out in a field stance, each hand a pole of the guarding field.

name: Sigilcinch
description: Throw two loops on two lines so the field covers both neck and arm.

name: Squallnoose
description: Step lightly across the field's width with one heel always lifted for a quick turn.

name: Statute Cordhandle
description: Load the cord with field qi until it will not cut and turns blades flat.

name: Gloomwire
description: Pull both cords against the target's own field in a steady push of counter-pressure.

name: Pall Handlebar
description: Echo a strike's force back along the cord's field and turn it from the body.

name: Authoritative Wirecore
description: Spread the field over both loops so they tighten as one living bond on neck and wrist.

name: Toggle Vow
description: Veil one cord in the field's glare while the other crosses unseen to the nape.

name: Statute Constrict
description: Flood the cords with field qi until the target's own qi falters at the throat.

name: Grand Slipnoose Triumph
description: Cast, veil, bind and close the paired cords within the field in the school's full finishing sequence.

name: Venerable Toggle
description: Root the stance from a formed core and hold both cords steady across the front.

name: Sigil Wirebraid
description: Release the two loops on one breath so they fall as a single motion.

name: Vigor Noosering
description: Pivot from the core's center so the whole body turns behind the cords in one piece.

name: Storied Throttle
description: Warm the cords from the core and draw them tight with a heat the skin cannot ignore.

name: Parity Cordbraid
description: Beat a blow aside with the cord's rebound, driven by a pulse of core qi.

name: Tighten Covenant
description: Send a thread from the core down each arm to keep both loops locked without grip.

name: Sigil Tighten
description: Feed the loops steadily from the core until the choke needs no strength from the hands.

name: Snaring Slipknot
description: Close a ring of paired cords around a spot so that anyone who steps into it is bound.

name: Cinchdecree
description: Draw the cords through a guard in one pulse of core qi that no mortal armor resists.

name: Resonant Season Noosering
description: Cast, anchor, feed and close the twin cords from the core in the canon's complete sequence.

name: Devout Gripdowel
description: Swear to the wind and stand square, the cord held across the belly as a guard.

name: Unbending Toggle
description: Throw the loop with the wind at the back so it flies true to the neck.

name: Strandsolace
description: Move low across the ground with the wind and let its noise cover the steps.

name: Paritystrand
description: Check the bearing of an incoming blow and turn the cord to take it off its line.

name: Triumphant Cinch
description: Pull in the rhythm of the oath, each breath of wind a beat of the draw.

name: Millstone Gripdowel
description: Seat a thread of qi in the knot and let the loop hold like a vow.

name: Nooseseal
description: Close the loop with a gale knot that tightens further whenever the target pulls.

name: Snaring Wirebraid
description: Run a cord across a narrow plateau trail so a hurried walker is thrown and tangled.

name: Garrote Banner
description: Draw on a sworn bearing through a guard that would turn any plain cord.

name: Destiny Barbedwire
description: Throw, bear, draw and knot in the school's whole sequence, finishing a contest with the oath fulfilled.

name: Enshrined Wirecore
description: Hold the cord taut as a sworn line across the chest and give no step back.

name: Thrall Cinch
description: Cast the loop from the lip of a rise so it drops onto a target below.

name: Surging Handlebar
description: Step along the heading you have sworn and let no feint turn you from it.

name: Cordhandle Crown
description: Draw the cord tight and keep it there like a promise kept to the end.

name: Parity Barbedwire
description: Slip the cord out of a seizing hand like a gale slipping through fingers.

name: Haemal Throttle
description: Lash the cord tip on the mark of the wind to a point below the ear.

name: Crushing Cordbraid
description: Cinch the sworn knot with one twist so that it holds until the oath is released.

name: Venom Slipknot
description: Stretch a net of cords across a gap in the rock so a fleeing band tangles in it.

name: Gloomcinch
description: Surge qi down the sworn cord in gusts that bend the target's strength and breath.

name: Harmonious Gripdowel
description: Swear, cast, draw and cinch in the book's last page of the oath, closing the loop for the whole school.

name: Unyielding Cordbraid
description: Keep the eyes on the target's neck while the cord guards the front in a level bar.

name: Thrall Wirecore
description: Cast the loop along the line of sight so it drops where the eyes rest.

name: Constrict Grace
description: Hold one course across open ground and let the target walk into the cord's reach.

name: Vigor Slipnoose
description: Snap the cord against the wrist along the heading and open the grip.

name: Gloom Noosering
description: Keep the same bearing while the pull deepens and ignore every twist of the head.

name: Deluge Cordhandle
description: Turn off the line of a rush and bring the cord back onto the bearing.

name: Strandmercy
description: Follow the target's turns through the cord and correct the pull after each.

name: Vising Tighten
description: Seat the loop on the bearing and hold it while the target tries every way to turn.

name: Beguiling Slipknot
description: Run two cords on crossing headings over a trail so a runner is caught whichever way he veers.

name: Vacuum Handlebar
description: Draw on the bearing so hard that the cord parts mail and finds the neck beneath.

name: Harmonious Volition Wirebraid
description: Cast, correct, seat and draw on one bearing in the school's whole teaching of the cord.

name: Sacrosanct Gripdowel
description: Hold the cord across the front with no wall behind, trusting only the line to stop a rush.

name: Thrallstrand
description: Cast the loop from the plateau's edge so it falls past a guard that is looking outward.

name: Toggle Solace
description: Cross open ground in wide steps with the eyes on the horizon until the last pace.

name: Undaunted Toggle
description: Time a parry to a gust so the cord rides the wind against a cut.

name: Cinchbanner
description: Lean into the pull as into a steady wind and give the target no moment to slip it.

name: Crushing Cinch
description: Slip a hand free of a grab and re-throw the loop over the grabbing wrist.

name: Tyrannous Slipnoose
description: Close the lineage's choke with the cord anchored at the hip and the wind adding its weight.

name: Beguiling Barbedwire
description: Stretch a cord low along the edge of a ridge so a fleeing runner is thrown over it.

name: Millstone Throttle
description: Surge the pull in gusts across the neck until the target's qi gives way with his breath.

name: Symphonic Throttle Crown
description: Throw from the edge, ride the gust, anchor and close in the lineage's one unbroken sequence.

name: Adamant Wirecore
description: Swear the oath into the field and stand with the cord taut at the front of it.

name: Vising Slipknot
description: Cast the loop on the field's moving air so it bends toward the neck.

name: Cinchgrace
description: Step along the edge of a gust, never into its center, to arrive unheard.

name: Noosedecree
description: Lash the field-charged cord across the lead hand to knock a weapon loose.

name: Volition Constrict
description: Hold the cord's tension in the field so it does not slacken however the target struggles.

name: Squall Wirebraid
description: Draw a veil of wind-laden field qi across the body to turn a thrust aside.

name: Commanding Garrote
description: Run a sworn thread of qi through the field to keep the loop locked on the neck.

name: Wiregift
description: Read the heading of the target's qi through the cord and shift the pull to meet it.

name: Sigilwire
description: Spread field qi through the loop so it closes with the full surge of a gale.

name: Noosevow
description: Spread a field of unseen cords over a plateau stretch to catch those who cross it.

name: Magnificent Cordbraid
description: Overwhelm the throat with the gale's full field until the target's qi and breath fail together.

name: Choral Handlebar
description: Swear, cast, read, spread and close in the school's complete mastery sequence of the field cord.

name: Undefiled Noosering
description: Stand rooted with the formed core as the anchor and the cord taut as the guard.

name: Sigil Garrote
description: Cast the loop from the core's turn so the whole body drives the throw.

name: Deluge Cinch
description: Step on a turn of the core so the body moves behind the cord at the wind's speed.

name: Gloomstrand
description: Draw the cord in gusts that rise from the core and beat upon the neck.

name: Parity Slipknot
description: Beat a blow aside with a rebound of core qi and slip the cord around it.

name: Sigilnoose
description: Send a thread of core qi along the cord so the loop stays locked without the hands.

name: Thrallwire
description: Feed the loop from the core in rising gusts until the choke holds without effort.

name: Sigil Gripdowel
description: Close a ring of cords about a spot so that anyone who steps in is bound at once.

name: Thunderclap Garrote
description: Break through any guard with one pulse of core qi down a drawn cord.

description: Cast, step, feed, ring and close the cord from the core in the canon's complete sequence.
